SUPERSEDED (B-SPLIT-MSG-120, agent 120) — growth-project-backend#660 @ 6055648506036c4b649cc7958c50ff86c132e997

This PR (3,041 changed lines) is superseded by a four-piece stacked split, each under 1,500 changed lines, with main ee55f814 merged in once:
- #708 MSG split 1/4 (schema, RLS, erasure entries; inert) @ 5c9c6a0e512e5bac1185e51e877d306684a84a3e, 459 lines, base main
- #709 MSG split 2/4 (flag, errors, MessagingService) @ 87f0bfffa9663661c7b1fe61fd892dbdaa59469a, 1,141 lines, base #708
- #710 MSG split 3/4 (actions + inbox services) @ 47b528ceb99eeaf0b2805c73cedf65936ed7db29, 1,092 lines, base #709
- #711 MSG split 4/4 (routes) @ 5a7c41e89ff6f79fc02fd8bab06e7b83bd11d666, 388 lines, base #710

Top tree of #711 equals this PR merged with main (reference `agent120/msg-split-0-merged-reference` @ cd130ae4cd4e0f72657110e980fc1ccd73ab5910; tree 2ba9ed0815f36b6b0b7d20b7cd4ba252fb2ff749). Split only: no behaviour change beyond the main-merge resolutions listed in each piece's body.
The community-live-tests failure on this PR (RLS on "CoachMessage" not enabled by the migration chain) carries over unchanged to every piece; it is an operator decision (D1 in ops report B-SPLIT-MSG-120).
This PR stays open for reference; do not merge it.
